Definition: from a compound of G575 and the base of G1476; a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy:--draught.
BiblicalUsage: A privy, a draught — Jesus' plain teaching that what goes into the mouth passes into the draught and is cast out, so it cannot defile a man. The word appears only in this teaching, and it is deliberately earthy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus chose the plainest picture on purpose: defilement comes from the heart, not from the stomach.
